description: A purpose-built KPI tile for Power BI — clean layout, dynamic accent colour, change pill, and subtitle, all driven by your data. Codex KPI Card replaces Power BI's built-in card visual with a tile that communicates status at a glance. Every element — value, label, subtitle, change indicator, accent border — is configurable from the format pane or driven directly from your measures. New in v2: background transparency, a full border card, conditional-formatting (fx) colour rules, and premium corner-accent chrome. IDEAL FOR Executive dashboards where clarity and pixel efficiency matter Multi-metric pages with consistent card styling across 4 to 36 KPIs Operational monitoring where green / amber / red status must be obvious at a glance Report templates that must match strict corporate brand guidelines KEY FEATURES Dynamic accent colour driven by a measure — each card reflects its own status Change pill with directional arrow — supports up-is-good, down-is-good, or neutral logic Subtitle line for context — e.g. "vs last week", "YTD", "estimated cost" Measure-driven text colour — value colour aligns with card status Full font controls on every text element — family, size, bold, italic, underline, alignment, colour Optional internal title with full font and alignment controls Hover tooltip showing measure name, value, subtitle, and change details Click to cross-filter other…
